summary: NexGen Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report on Form 8-K) to furnish a news release dated November 5, 2026, announcing a Q3 2026 conference call on November 10, 2026, at 8:00 am Eastern. Management will update construction progress at the 100%-owned Rook I uranium project and Patterson Corridor East exploration, with Q3 financials and MD&A to be filed November 9. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated; this is a routine earnings-call notice, not a special situation.
